verdict.rationale: Speechmatics says it does not log customer data by default and offers on-device, on-prem and self-hosted deployment for complete data privacy. This implies customer audio stays out of vendor hands and so out of model training, but no evidence explicitly addresses training use. Missing for 10: an explicit no-training policy or training opt-out control, contractual/DPA terms on model training, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: Run Speechmatics on device, on prem and in the cloud depending on your privacy needs. We don’t log your data as standard.
Host our APIs in your environment, ensuring complete data privacy, infrastructure control
